in_sanskrit.name: नन्दिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is pleased or delighted, often used for a goddess or a woman who is in a joyful state.

in_hindi.name: नन्दिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रसन्न रात्रि (Prasanna Ratri) - A peaceful and propitious night, प्रसन्न वदन (Prasanna Vadan) - A pleased face, प्रसन्नता (Prasannata) - A state of being pleased or satisfied.

in_tamil.name: நந்திதா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is kind and compassionate, நல்ல வாழ்வு (Nalla Vaazhvu) - Good character, கிரத்தம் (Kirattam) - Compassion, அவன் (Avana) - He or she.

in_telugu.name: నందిదా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is pleased or delighted, often used for a goddess or a woman who is in a joyful state.

in_marathi.name: Nanditha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nanditha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who bestows happiness and joy to others.

in_bengali.name: Nanditha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joyful Giver
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nanditha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who bestows happiness and joy to others.
